name: The Tome of Valor
summary: At her Westfall farm, Daphne Stilwell calls for aid as the Defias Brotherhood closes in. A paladin must answer her plea.

sections.title: A Stand in the Dust
sections.body: The Defias Brotherhood still contests the land around Daphne's homestead. Earlier clashes have not ended the danger, and another assault is expected. You are sent to hold the ground beside her house. There is no retreat. Your pursuit of the virtues in the Tome of Valor now faces a test of courage.

sections.title: The Trial of Valor
sections.body: Daphne has only her own firearm, while you can call on the blessings of the Holy Light. Wave after wave of Defias raiders attacks, and the fight tests whether you can protect someone vulnerable under crushing pressure. True valor means standing between innocent civilians and ruthless violence, even when danger bears down on you.

faq.answer: Daphne Stilwell is a human homesteader in Westfall's grasslands. The Defias Brotherhood often intrudes on her land, but she refuses to leave and fights back against their raids.

faq.q: Why are the Defias attacking this specific farm?
faq.answer: The Defias Brotherhood has taken much of Westfall's countryside, driving farmers away or forcing them to submit. Daphne's husband, Jordan, is away in Ironforge, leaving her alone and unprotected. The Defias want her land.

faq.q: What is the Tome of Valor?
faq.answer: The Tome of Valor is a sacred text the Church of the Holy Light uses to guide young paladins. Knights-in-training face physical and spiritual trials across the kingdom to live by its virtues.

faq.q: What happens if Daphne falls during the battle?
faq.answer: If Daphne Stilwell falls in battle, the trial fails. Valor calls you to protect her life as well as your own from the bandit attack.

faq.q: Where does this attack take place?
faq.answer: The attack takes place outside Daphne Stilwell's farmhouse. Her small farm lies in the Dagger Hills, overlooking the Longshore in southern Westfall.

faq.q: What comes after defending the farm?
faq.answer: After you prove your courage and drive off the Defias raiders, Daphne acknowledges your devotion. She directs you toward the next phase of your paladin trials.

angles.text: As a paladin, you are tested as a steadfast protector. Holding the line beside Daphne puts valor into action as you shield the innocent from harm.
Stormwind's garrison is spread thin and cannot guard rural homesteads. Defending Westfall's loyal citizens falls to individual heroes.
